# Syncore Medical

> > Syncore Medical is a specialized real estate brokerage firm providing medical, dental, optical, and veterinary practice location selection, lease negotiation, and market analysis services across major Texas markets.

Founded by Sean Regan, Syncore Medical serves healthcare practitioners throughout Texas with expertise in practice startup, expansion, relocation, and demographic analysis. The firm maintains regional offices in Austin, Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio, leveraging deep market knowledge to help practitioners find optimal locations and negotiate favorable lease terms.
